$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every spec-derived balance constant. Per Constitution Principle I, balance changes edit this file ONLY; backend/src/MatchServer/Generated/BalanceConstants.cs and frontend/src/generated/balanceConstants.ts are code-generated from it by shared/codegen/generate.js and must never be hand-edited. Each entry cites the spec requirement it comes from.

movement.$spec: FR-001 (base speeds + multiplicative cornering penalty until next tile center), FR-006 (frightened), FR-009 (eyes-only)
movement.$note: baseTilesPerSecond is NOT spec-derived: the spec fixes only the RATIOS between roles (100% vs 95% etc.), never an absolute pace. It lives here so the one-edit-site rule still holds, but changing it alters feel, not balance - the ratios above are what the Success Criteria depend on.

frightened.$spec: FR-005 (8.0s, resets not stacks), FR-007 (3.0s input inversion), FR-009 (5.0s ghost house lockout)

vision.$spec: FR-011 (6-tile radius + line-of-sight; 4.0s sonar cadence, map-relative quadrant)

antiCamping.$spec: FR-012 (3-tile radius, 5.0s trigger, additional 15% reduction to 80% net; timer resets while Pac-Man visible)

match.$spec: FR-014 (180s), FR-002 (3 lives), FR-003 (5s ghost respawn), FR-017 (70% threshold), FR-004 (0.8x0.8 box), plan.md (~30Hz tick)
